status: G5 final batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-river-barge, in Chapters I, II, IV, VIII and X (on the web in Chapter II only)
use: A Danube cargo barge afloat on the distant river beyond the board's north edge, in the battles whose scenes have it.

generator.prompt: A Danube river barge: a broad flat-bottomed cargo boat about eight metres long and two point five metres wide with a square stern and a gently raised bow, loaded amidships with stacked grain sacks, amphorae bedded in straw and a few barrels under a lashed brown leather sheet, a long steering oar at the stern and two long punting poles laid along the side. Tarred dark planks, brown leather, pale sacking, straw and terracotta. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
